name: yoroll-test-plugin
description: Choose a Yoroll intent, reuse one OAuth login in the DEV Browser, and keep creation results visible.

interface.longDescription: A test-environment preview that keeps Yoroll open as a visible DEV workspace, uses one public MCP App card to choose an intent, and collects parameters through conversation. A short-lived one-time handoff projects the existing MCP OAuth identity into Codex's separate in-app Browser without another sign-in; every business change still uses an OAuth-protected Yoroll MCP tool.
